description: Score indicator with bands, label and size variations.

howToUse: Use it for a score from 0 to 100 shown at a glance: quality, health, match.
Pick `size` by place: `sm` in table rows, `md` in cards, `lg` at the top of a page.
Set the bands with `okAt` and `warnAt`, and say next to it what the score measures.
alternatives: A number with unit and trend: Stat.

keyboard.action: The gauge does not receive focus. Screen readers read the score and its label.

props.name: value
props.description: Score from 0 to 100 (out-of-range values are clamped).

props.name: label
props.description: Short label under the number (e.g. "Editorial"). Hidden at size sm.

props.name: okAt
props.description: Minimum score of the ok band (default 70).

props.name: warnAt
props.description: Minimum score of the warn band (default 40; below = critical).

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formatting of the central number (default: rounded integer).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible text of the meter. Required if `label` is not a string.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
